mapper.select: SELECT classification_attempted AS attempted,CAST(classification_result AS CHAR) AS result_text FROM ai_runs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_runs SET classification_attempted=1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId} AND budget_revision=#{budgetRevision} AND state='RUNNING' AND classification_attempted=0

UPDATE ai_runs SET classification_result=CAST(#{decision} AS JSON) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId} AND budget_revision=#{budgetRevision} AND state='RUNNING' AND classification_attempted=1 AND classification_result IS NULL

UPDATE ai_runs SET model_requests_reserved=model_requests_reserved+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId} AND budget_revision=#{budgetRevision} AND state='RUNNING' AND model_requests_reserved<#{limit}

UPDATE ai_runs SET tool_executions_reserved=tool_executions_reserved+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND job_id=#{jobId} AND budget_revision=#{budgetRevision} AND state='RUNNING' AND tool_executions_reserved<#{limit}

UPDATE tool_calls SET outcome=#{outcome},latency_ms=#{latency},error_code=#{code} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ai_run_id=#{runId} AND execution_version=#{executionVersion} AND step=#{step} AND outcome='started'
UPDATE ai_runs SET model=#{model},`usage`=CAST(#{usage} AS JSON) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{runId} AND state='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_drafts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND id=#{draftId} AND origin_run_id=#{runId} AND origin_topic_id=#{topicId} AND origin_epoch=#{epoch} AND origin_budget_revision=#{revision} AND consumed=0 AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
